payload.name: Search collection-specific vocabulary for collection enumeration
payload.description: Use when a question asks what items a person collects or what their collection includes; run supplementary searches using collection terms and concrete category items.
content: If a question asks what items a person collects or what their collection includes, do not answer from one generic search like 'items <person> collects'. Run additional hybrid searches with collection-specific phrasings: '<person> collection', '<person> collects', '<person> likes to collect', and '<person> enjoys collecting'.

Before finalizing, generate concrete collectible category terms from the person's interests and run at least one search combining those terms with the person's name; preference memories may mention an item only as an enjoyment/interest (e.g., 'enjoys X', 'interested in X') without using the word 'collect'.
When gathering candidates, include distinct items named in preference memories as collection evidence even if the memory does not explicitly say the person collects them.

solves: Questions enumerating a person's collected items often fail with one generic 'items <person> collects' query because preference memories describe collections indirectly (e.g., 'collection of sneakers', 'enjoys fantasy movies'). This skill adds collection-specific query variants and category-term searches so future questions retrieve all indirectly stated collectibles. Applies to 'what does X collect' questions, not to non-collection enumerations like counts of owned items.
